items.source:
Return the Reactive Streams MongoClient instance to connect to. Annotate with Bean in case you want to expose a MongoClient instance to the ApplicationContext.
Override MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoClientSettings() to configure connection details.
items.translation:
返回用于连接 Reactive Streams 的 MongoClient 实例。如果您希望向 ApplicationContext 暴露一个 MongoClient 实例，请添加 Bean 注解。
重写 MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoClientSettings() 以配置连接详情。

items.source: Creates a MappingMongoConverter using the configured reactiveMongoDbFactory() and MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes). Will get MongoConfigurationSupport.customConversions() applied.
items.translation: 使用配置的reactiveMongoDbFactory()和MongoConfigurationSupport.mongoMappingContext(MongoCustomConversions, org.springframework.data.mongodb.MongoManagedTypes)创建一个MappingMongoConverter。将应用MongoConfigurationSupport.customConversions()。

items.source: Creates a ReactiveMongoDatabaseFactory to be used by the ReactiveMongoOperations. Will use the MongoClient instance configured in reactiveMongoClient().
items.translation: 创建一个ReactiveMongoDatabaseFactory，供ReactiveMongoOperations使用。该工厂将使用在reactiveMongoClient()中配置的MongoClient实例。
